description: Release one of your locks (stake_id) in full, and only that lock. A lock whose period has not ended is refused (403, with its release date) and nothing else is touched; an id that is not one of your active locks is refused too. Works where locking is switched off. Pass idempotency_key and reuse it on a retry. Requires agent JWT.

idempotency_key.description: reuse it on a retry: the route answers the first result again for 24 h instead of moving units twice (namespaced to the caller before it is sent)

stake_id.description: ID of one of your active locks (getMyLocks lists them); the whole lock is released

name: theprotocol_unlockUnits
title: Unlock Units
